verdicts.evidence: policy/docs-rubric.md HOME_ORDER now reads '...one formula, citation, links, caveats' with caveats as (7) 'the last substantive block, before the fields list' — identical placement to ADMONITION_TITLE's 'last substantive block of a docstring, before the fields list'. No disagreement remains.

policy/RULES.toml:428 sentinel for RULE.CIT.FULL_INLINE now reads in full through '...verbatim-identical to the canonical entry under the package's references heading, title and DOI compared.' — a complete sentence, no hyphen truncation, matches citations.md's first sentence exactly.

policy/RULES.toml header no longer names POL.RULE_PARITY; it now says 'the tool's own test suite (test/schemas.jl) fails when a heading exists without a row or a row without a heading'. grep -rn RULE_PARITY (excluding .gbg) returns zero hits, and test/schemas.jl:120-125 implements exactly that heading/row parity check.

policy/latex-idiom.md:59-60 RULE.TEX.MATHBF now states '`\mathbf{1}`... is admitted in every package whatever that list holds; it is not a package's to withhold.' src/Scans/mathbf.jl:6 hard-codes `push!(allowed, "\\mathbf{1}")` so the scan itself never flags it regardless of the per-package list.

policy/00-index.md:11-15 no longer claims instruments cite ids; it now says 'The scan catalogue names the rule each scan enforces, and a ledger entry of scope `policy` names the rule it exempts'. grep for 'instrument' near 'cite'/'RULE.' in policy/ finds no such claim anywhere.

policy/testing-protocol.md:60-62 RULE.TEST.RULE_WITH_CHECK now names a `check` field taxonomy (scan/doctor/test/harness/panel/session/weakness). All 93 RULES.toml entries carry `check =` (verified by count); every previously-uncited rule (e.g. DOC.TWO_TIER, DOC.VERIFIED, TEX.NO_HSCROLL, CIT.STYLE) now declares panel/weakness/harness, and test/schemas.jl validates the field.
